verdict.rationale: Perplexity ships a built-in 'Assistant' that can draft emails, schedule appointments, and book reservations, plus a 'Computer' agent that browses the web, executes code in a sandbox, and connects to 400+ services via OAuth—clear built-in task-delegation capability (perplexity-docs-9, perplexity-docs-28, perplexity-docs-17, perplexity-docs-29, perplexity-docs-30, perplexity-docs-19). However, hands-on community reports say the 'Computer' research feature 'often fails to trigger via the UI, and when it does work, sessions frequently stall without returning an answer,' directly contradicting the reliability of this delegation feature (perplexity-comm-7). Missing for 10: independent verification that Assistant task completion (bookings/emails) reliably succeeds, and resolution of the stalling/failure reports.
